model.title: U.S. Tech PATH Act
model.meta: Foreign Relations Committee · Sen. Jeanne Shaheen (D-NH)

summary.text: The bill would streamline the process for foreign governments to purchase American-made cybersecurity and digital technologies, while providing incentives to encourage these purchases. It aims to make it easier and more attractive for U.S. allies and partners to buy American cyber and digital products and services.
